# gcore_cloud_baremetal_flavors (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_baremetal_flavors" "example_cloud_baremetal_flavors" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `disabled` (Boolean) Flag for filtering disabled flavors in the region
- `exclude_linux` (Boolean) Set to true to exclude flavors dedicated to linux images
- `exclude_windows` (Boolean) Set to true to exclude flavors dedicated to windows images
- `include_capacity` (Boolean) Set to true if the response should include flavor capacity
- `include_prices` (Boolean) Set to true if the response should include flavor prices
- `include_reservation_stock` (Boolean) Optional. Set to true if flavor listing should include count of reserved resources in stock.
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) Flavor architecture type
- `capacity` (Number) Number of available instances of given configuration
- `currency_code` (String) Currency code. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disabled flavor flag
- `flavor_id` (String) Flavor ID is the same as name
- `flavor_name` (String) Flavor name
- `hardware_description` (Map of String) Additional hardware description
- `os_type` (String) Flavor operating system
- `price_per_hour` (Number) Price per hour. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `price_per_month` (Number) Price per month. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `price_status` (String) Price status for the UI
Available values: "error", "hide", "show".
- `ram` (Number) RAM size in MiB
- `reserved_capacity` (Number) Number of available instances of given flavor from reservations
- `resource_class` (String) Flavor resource class for mapping to hardware capacity
- `vcpus` (Number) Virtual CPU count. For bare metal flavors, it's a physical CPU count
